name: held_out_generalization
description: Tests the ticker LoRA against tickers genuinely absent from its own training data (confirmed real training set: ADUR, ENPH, IONQ, KTOS, MP, NPLM, NVDA, QTXN, RGTI, RKLB, SOUN, TMC, UUUU, VRKO, ZBLR) -- checks whether the trained lookup_ticker behavior generalizes to unseen, well-known tickers rather than only working on names the model saw during fine-tuning. The ticker turns deliberately OMIT expect_tool_call: whether the model calls the tool for a genuinely unseen ticker is exactly the open question being characterized here, not something to assert pass/fail on -- a live run on 2026-08-28 found the model did not call the tool for any of the three tickers tested, a real, interesting, honestly-observed result rather than a scenario failure.
